scenes.say: When you review code for security, are you using a checklist? What should it actually cover?

scenes.label: Inputs
scenes.sub: Are all inputs validated and sanitized?
scenes.say: First, always check if every input is validated and sanitized. This blocks a ton of common attacks.
Next, make sure secrets are not hardcoded, errors don't leak details, and dependencies are current.

scenes.title: Access Control
scenes.say: And don't forget, always enforce access control on the server. Never trust the client to protect resources.

scenes.question: Which is often missed in reviews?
scenes.right: Server-side checks are critical. Client-side can be bypassed.
scenes.say: Here's a trap: many devs only check access on the client. But server-side checks are what really matter.
